title: AI-CTA: AI-Industrial Predictive Safety
description:
Research implementation for industrial anomaly detection, RUL estimation, risk fusion, and conformal threshold calibration. The sensor/REST demo serves detector-plus-rules risk. A separate adaptive pipeline consumes precomputed asynchronous risk channels and applies guarded recalibration.

Includes unit/integration tests, historical benchmarks, and separate replication packages for the PeerJ and governed-adaptation studies. See each package for protocol, version, data, and reference-result provenance. Marginal conformal guarantees require exchangeability; this software has no safety certification or field-validation claim. DOI/version metadata must identify the actual archived release.
